items.text: Requesting the Controller to allot funds and to draw warrants against such funds available or will be available in payment of the following claim against the SFMTA: (Explanatory documents include a resolution.) A. Debra Reese vs. City and County San Francisco et al., Superior Ct. Case No. CGC-22-597945 filed 02/01/2022 for $425,000. Lawsuit involving allegations that SFMTA violated fair employment laws. (Note: This item was previously heard as an informational item by the SFMTA Board in Closed Session on December 17, 2024.) B. Farmers Insurance Exchange/Chuong Trieu Chau, Unlitigated Claim No. C25- 0079 for $117,614.81 (SFMTA to receive). Claim involving allegations of property damage to City property. RESOLUTION No. 250204-007 No public comment.
